苔庭攀崖羊灵领誓·伊珀.zh: 羊的角里卡着一颗门铃，它低头吃草时，屋里便有人应门。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭攀崖羊灵领誓·伊珀.en: A doorbell is caught in the goat’s horn. Whenever it lowers its head to graze, someone answers inside. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭晶棘蜥龙领誓·依珀.zh: 桥下留下成片的鳞屑，最大的一片比失踪车辆的车门还宽。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭晶棘蜥龙领誓·依珀.en: Sheets of scale remain beneath the bridge. The largest is wider than the missing car’s door. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭裂角客领誓·诺珀.zh: 额骨撑破了旧帽子的边缘，证件上仍写着一个普通职业。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭裂角客领誓·诺珀.en: The forehead has split the old cap. The identity card still lists an ordinary occupation. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭灯议长·洛珀.zh: 他用示波器听取墙内的声音，波形偶尔排成一行可读的字。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭灯议长·洛珀.en: He listens to the wall through an oscilloscope. Sometimes the waveform arranges itself into readable words. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭晶棘蜥龙领誓·岚珀.zh: 它收拢翅膀时遮住了月亮，水面上却没有多出一块阴影。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭晶棘蜥龙领誓·岚珀.en: Its folded wings cover the moon. No additional shadow appears on the water. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭浮辉使领誓·索珀.zh: 门禁只记下了一个人的重量，监控里却有两个影子走进来。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭浮辉使领誓·索珀.en: The access sensor recorded one person’s weight. Two shadows enter on the camera feed. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭峰脊巨灵领誓·莱珀.zh: 门框上的刻痕一年比一年高，房主却坚持房客从未长大。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭峰脊巨灵领誓·莱珀.en: The marks on the doorframe rise each year. The landlord insists the tenant has never grown. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭裂角客领誓·岑珀.zh: 它的影子有两种轮廓，轮到报姓名时，只有其中一个动嘴。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭裂角客领誓·岑珀.en: Its shadow has two outlines. Only one mouth moves when it gives a name. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭地缝蠕虫领誓·塔珀.zh: 虫身里能看见吞下的纸条，上面的字朝着相反方向缓慢爬动。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭地缝蠕虫领誓·塔珀.en: A swallowed note shows through the worm’s body. Its letters move slowly in the opposite direction. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭枝灯树灵领誓·莫珀.zh: 墙内长出的根缠着旧电线，切断电源后仍会轻轻发热。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭枝灯树灵领誓·莫珀.en: Roots inside the wall coil around old wiring. They stay warm after the power is cut. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭巡影狼领誓·伦珀.zh: 狼群的脚印在路口分开，回到现场时却全都穿过同一张照片。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭巡影狼领誓·伦珀.en: The pack’s tracks divide at the crossing. At the scene, every trail passes through the same photograph. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭灯议长·佩珀.zh: 他记得你的脸，却坚持你们第一次见面是在明天的停尸房。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭灯议长·佩珀.en: He remembers your face. He insists you first met tomorrow, in the morgue. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭灯议长·泽珀.zh: 她在空白磁带上做记号，说录音是从擦掉的部分开始的。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭灯议长·泽珀.en: She marks a blank tape. She says the recording begins in the part that was erased. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭镜瞳山猫领誓·芮珀.zh: 猫从不碰那只纸箱，夜里却会向箱内一个看不见的东西让路。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭镜瞳山猫领誓·芮珀.en: The cat never touches the box. At night it steps aside for something leaving it. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭铠卫·乌恩.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铠卫·乌恩.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭铠卫·依恩.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铠卫·依恩.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭巡灯使·诺恩.zh: 她把口供念得很慢，每到自己的名字，窗外就响起刹车声。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭巡灯使·诺恩.en: She reads her statement slowly. Tires screech outside whenever she reaches her name. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭峰脊巨灵·瑟恩.zh: 它坐过的椅子没有断，地基却像被什么东西往下按了一寸。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭峰脊巨灵·瑟恩.en: The chair it sat on remains intact. The foundation looks as if something pressed it an inch lower. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭缄骨客·维恩.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭缄骨客·维恩.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭观灯师·希恩.zh: 他的测绘纸只画房间内侧，折起之后，外面便多出一扇门。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭观灯师·希恩.en: His survey shows only the inside of the room. Folded shut, it leaves an extra door outside. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭观灯师·洛恩.zh: 她念出一串没人接听的号码，停电的屋子逐间亮起了灯。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭观灯师·洛恩.en: She recites numbers nobody answers. Lights come on one by one in houses without power. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭观灯师·米恩.zh: 他把静电噪声抄进本子，错别字在第二天都变成了人名。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭观灯师·米恩.en: He copies static into a notebook. By morning, every misspelling has become a person’s name. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭观灯师·岚恩.zh: 仪表没有连电源，他却要求你别在指针停住时看向窗外。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭观灯师·岚恩.en: The meter has no power supply. He asks you not to look outside when its needle stops. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭巡灯使·索恩.zh: 这名乘客一直握着空票夹，说目的地写在车站的另一面。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭巡灯使·索恩.en: The passenger holds an empty ticket wallet. He says the destination is on the other side of the station. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭织光蛛·莱恩.zh: 蛛网没有粘住飞虫，空出的结点却对应着几处失踪者的住址。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭织光蛛·莱恩.en: No insects are caught in the web. Its empty junctions correspond to missing persons’ addresses. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭修灯师·岑恩.zh: 她给伤口换上新的绷带，拆下来的旧布里却没有一点血。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭修灯师·岑恩.en: She changes the dressing. There is no blood anywhere in the cloth she removes. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭修灯师·塔恩.zh: 这名医师听诊很久，最后问你有没有梦见另一个心跳声。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭修灯师·塔恩.en: The physician listens for a long time, then asks whether you have dreamed of a second heartbeat. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭修灯师·伦恩.zh: 她认得每个人的伤痕，却说不清这些记录是哪一次看诊写的。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭修灯师·伦恩.en: She knows every scar. She cannot say which consultation produced the notes. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭铠卫·佩恩.zh: 这名警卫从不摘手套，交回的钥匙却每次都带着新的指纹。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铠卫·佩恩.en: The guard never removes his gloves. The returned keys bear a fresh fingerprint each time. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭峰脊巨灵·泽恩.zh: 他只需伸手就能碰到屋顶，却低头说自己被关在很小的地方。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭峰脊巨灵·泽恩.en: He can touch the roof without standing. Looking down, he says he is confined somewhere very small. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭潜印客·图恩.zh: 锁没有被撬开的痕迹，屋里却多出一件尺寸合适的雨衣。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭潜印客·图恩.en: The lock shows no damage. A raincoat in exactly the right size has appeared inside. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭潜印客·芮恩.zh: 他收走你的照片，只归还底片，说照片会替别人认出你。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭潜印客·芮恩.en: He takes your photograph and returns only the negative. He says a print lets someone else recognize you. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭环藤蛇·阿拉.zh: 蛇蜕从锁孔里拖出来，里面还包着一张没有签名的借条。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭环藤蛇·阿拉.en: A shed snakeskin trails from the keyhole, wrapped around an unsigned note of debt. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭环藤蛇·艾拉.zh: 它盘着一只早已停走的表，表针却一直跟着鳞片慢慢移动。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭环藤蛇·艾拉.en: It coils around a stopped watch. The hands keep moving with the scales. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭缄骨客·伊拉.zh: 封棺时少了一颗钉子，后来在他的外衣口袋里找到了。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭缄骨客·伊拉.en: A nail was missing when the coffin was sealed. It was later found in his coat pocket. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭缄骨客·欧拉.zh: 它的牙齿已经不齐，录音里的齿音却清楚得像贴着话筒。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭缄骨客·欧拉.en: Its teeth are incomplete. The sibilants on the tape sound as if its mouth is pressed to the microphone. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭巡灯使·乌拉.zh: 他来报失踪，拿出的照片是自己，背面写着尚未发生的事。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭巡灯使·乌拉.en: He comes to report a disappearance. The photograph is his own, with events that have not happened written on the back. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭绒伞菌灵·依拉.zh: 菌褶下沾着旧打字机的色带，孢子落地后排成了几个错字。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭绒伞菌灵·依拉.en: An old typewriter ribbon clings beneath the cap. The falling spores form a few misspelled words. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭观灯师·雅拉.zh: 他用示波器听取墙内的声音，波形偶尔排成一行可读的字。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭观灯师·雅拉.en: He listens to the wall through an oscilloscope. Sometimes the waveform arranges itself into readable words. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭铠卫·诺拉.zh: 巡逻靴始终干净，鞋底夹着的泥却来自一条已经填平的河。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铠卫·诺拉.en: The patrol boots stay clean. Mud caught in the soles comes from a river that was filled in. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭观灯师·瑟拉.zh: 她在空白磁带上做记号，说录音是从擦掉的部分开始的。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭观灯师·瑟拉.en: She marks a blank tape. She says the recording begins in the part that was erased. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭琉纹缄骨客.zh: 他记得被埋在哪里，却总把回家的路说成另一座墓的地址。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭琉纹缄骨客.en: He remembers where he was buried. His directions home always end at another grave. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭风蚀缄骨客.zh: 这具身体的旧伤都合上了，缝线却在向皮肤外缓慢生长。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭风蚀缄骨客.en: The body’s old wounds have closed. The sutures are slowly growing out through the skin. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭静棱缄骨客.zh: 它不追赶活人，只会跟着那些已经登记过死亡的姓名走。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭静棱缄骨客.en: It does not pursue the living. It follows names that have already been entered in the death register. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭绒雾缄骨客.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭绒雾缄骨客.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭微烛潜印客.zh: 她会替人藏起证词，但每份副本都在最不该出现的地方找到。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭微烛潜印客.en: She hides statements for people. Every copy is found where it ought least to be. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭苔痕棱耳猎犬.zh: 狗把鼻尖贴在空白相片上，随后一直等在没有门的那面墙前。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭苔痕棱耳猎犬.en: The dog presses its nose to a blank photograph, then waits beside the wall without a door. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭苔痕线尾鼠.zh: 老鼠把文件边缘啃得很齐，却从来不碰写着姓名的那一栏。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭苔痕线尾鼠.en: The rat trims the file’s edges neatly. It never touches the column containing names. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭铜缄线尾鼠.zh: 它叼走的钥匙都生着旧锈，鼠洞里却总传出开新锁的声音。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铜缄线尾鼠.en: The keys it steals are rusted. The sound from its hole is always a new lock opening. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭苔痕砂脊蜥.zh: 蜥蜴的尾巴留在证物盘里，身体却每天回来替它换一个位置。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭苔痕砂脊蜥.en: The lizard’s tail lies in an evidence tray. Its body returns each day to move it. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭苔痕露囊蛙.zh: 蛙卵里浮着细小的黑点，放大后看起来像一排站着的人。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭苔痕露囊蛙.en: Dark specks float inside the frogspawn. Enlarged, they resemble a line of standing people. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭苔痕凝光泥团.zh: 它在地上留下湿润的轮廓，像一个人曾经在这里躺了很久。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭苔痕凝光泥团.en: Its damp outline remains on the floor, as if a person lay there for a long time. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭铜缄枝灯树灵.zh: 叶脉像一张熟悉的街区图，缺的那条巷子从来没有人走出来。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铜缄枝灯树灵.en: The leaf veins resemble a familiar street map. Nobody has ever returned from the missing lane. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭铜缄绒伞菌灵.zh: 它只在有人空出的座位上长出，座位离开房间后也一样。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铜缄绒伞菌灵.en: It grows only on vacated seats, even after those seats are taken out of the room. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭回声绒伞菌灵.zh: 菌褶下沾着旧打字机的色带，孢子落地后排成了几个错字。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭回声绒伞菌灵.en: An old typewriter ribbon clings beneath the cap. The falling spores form a few misspelled words. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭流砂铠卫.zh: 他的证件照闭着眼，见到你之后，照片里的眼睛才睁开。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭流砂铠卫.en: His identification photograph has its eyes shut. They open after he meets you. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭镜纹铠卫.zh: 外套里面缝着许多旧徽章，最靠近心口的一枚没有编号。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭镜纹铠卫.en: Old badges line his coat. The one nearest his heart has no number. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭远路铠卫.zh: 他答应守住那扇门，问到里面是什么时，却先看你的背后。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭远路铠卫.en: He promises to hold the door. Asked what is inside, he looks behind you before answering. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭石封铠卫.zh: 警棍上留着细密的齿印，他说那不是用来打人的一端。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭石封铠卫.en: Fine tooth marks cover the baton. He says they are on the end he never uses to strike. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭鸣枝铠卫.zh: 这套旧甲只在无人说话时响动，像有人仍在里面找出口。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭鸣枝铠卫.en: The old armor moves only when the room falls silent, as though someone inside is looking for a way out. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭暖灰铠卫.zh: 他承认曾经离开岗位，却拒绝说明是谁替他签完了整夜。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭暖灰铠卫.en: He admits leaving his post. He will not say who signed the log for the rest of the night. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭夜航缄骨客.zh: 封棺时少了一颗钉子，后来在他的外衣口袋里找到了。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭夜航缄骨客.en: A nail was missing when the coffin was sealed. It was later found in his coat pocket. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭流砂缄骨客.zh: 它的牙齿已经不齐，录音里的齿音却清楚得像贴着话筒。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭流砂缄骨客.en: Its teeth are incomplete. The sibilants on the tape sound as if its mouth is pressed to the microphone. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭夜航观灯师.zh: 他的测绘纸只画房间内侧，折起之后，外面便多出一扇门。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭夜航观灯师.en: His survey shows only the inside of the room. Folded shut, it leaves an extra door outside. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭镜纹缄骨客.zh: 他记得被埋在哪里，却总把回家的路说成另一座墓的地址。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭镜纹缄骨客.en: He remembers where he was buried. His directions home always end at another grave. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭远路缄骨客.zh: 这具身体的旧伤都合上了，缝线却在向皮肤外缓慢生长。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭远路缄骨客.en: The body’s old wounds have closed. The sutures are slowly growing out through the skin. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭回声环藤蛇.zh: 水管里传来吐信声，维修图上却没有画出这条管道。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭回声环藤蛇.en: A tongue flicks inside the pipe. The maintenance plan shows no pipe in that position. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭微烛环藤蛇.zh: 蛇蜕从锁孔里拖出来，里面还包着一张没有签名的借条。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭微烛环藤蛇.en: A shed snakeskin trails from the keyhole, wrapped around an unsigned note of debt. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭琉纹峰脊巨灵.zh: 这名搬运工搬得动整台锅炉，却从不碰那只没有上锁的箱子。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭琉纹峰脊巨灵.en: The porter can move a whole boiler. He will not touch the unlocked box beside it. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭风蚀裂角客.zh: 他不肯越过地面的盐线，盐粒却在你眨眼时排到了门外。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭风蚀裂角客.en: He will not cross the line of salt. Between blinks, the grains rearrange themselves outside the door. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭铜缄浮辉使.zh: 它站在被擦掉的名字旁边，像还在等谁补上最后一笔。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铜缄浮辉使.en: It stands beside the erased name, as though waiting for someone to finish the final stroke. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭悬灯铠卫.zh: 值勤腰带少了一样东西，空出来的位置比枪套还要重。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭悬灯铠卫.en: Something is missing from the duty belt. The empty space weighs more than the holster. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭微烛晶棘蜥龙.zh: 高处传来巨大的抓挠声，屋顶的灰尘却都从里面向外扬起。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭微烛晶棘蜥龙.en: Heavy claws scrape overhead. Dust rises from inside the roof and drifts outward. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭琉纹晶棘蜥龙.zh: 照片只拍到了它的一只眼，取景器里却一直显示两张脸。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭琉纹晶棘蜥龙.en: The photograph catches one eye. The viewfinder continues to register two faces. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭苔痕掠风鸟.zh: 这只鸟学会了电话的铃声，来电记录却总是在它叫过后才出现。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭苔痕掠风鸟.en: The bird has learned a telephone’s ring. The call appears in the log only after it cries. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭琉纹潜印客.zh: 他从不走有脚印的那条路，仍会在转角撞见自己的背影。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭琉纹潜印客.en: He avoids paths with footprints. At the next corner he still finds his own back. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭铜缄凝光泥团.zh: 玻璃后面的黏液跟着问话缓慢起伏，没人记录它答了什么。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铜缄凝光泥团.en: The substance behind the glass rises and falls with the questions. Nobody records its answers. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭石封缄骨客.zh: 它不追赶活人，只会跟着那些已经登记过死亡的姓名走。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭石封缄骨客.en: It does not pursue the living. It follows names that have already been entered in the death register. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭铜缄地缝蠕虫.zh: 它沿着地缝前行，身后露出的砖面比房屋本身更陈旧。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭铜缄地缝蠕虫.en: It follows the crack in the floor, exposing brickwork older than the house. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭苔痕折面星客.zh: 它照着录音学会了敲门，敲击之间却没有留给人开门的时间。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭苔痕折面星客.en: It learned to knock from a recording. The intervals leave nobody time to open the door. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭静棱裂角客.zh: 窗玻璃映出弯曲的角，站在玻璃前的人却戴着平整的帽子。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭静棱裂角客.en: Curved horns appear in the window. The person standing before it wears an undamaged hat. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭银露铠卫.zh: 他检查每个人的通行证，轮到自己时，指尖总会停很久。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭银露铠卫.en: He checks every pass. When he reaches his own, his fingers remain still for a long time. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭风蚀峰脊巨灵.zh: 门框上的刻痕一年比一年高，房主却坚持房客从未长大。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭风蚀峰脊巨灵.en: The marks on the doorframe rise each year. The landlord insists the tenant has never grown. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭流砂观灯师.zh: 她念出一串没人接听的号码，停电的屋子逐间亮起了灯。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭流砂观灯师.en: She recites numbers nobody answers. Lights come on one by one in houses without power. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭琉纹环藤蛇.zh: 它盘着一只早已停走的表，表针却一直跟着鳞片慢慢移动。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭琉纹环藤蛇.en: It coils around a stopped watch. The hands keep moving with the scales. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭苔痕潮纹游鱼.zh: 鱼鳃里夹着一小块墙纸，花纹与失踪者卧室的照片相同。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭苔痕潮纹游鱼.en: A scrap of wallpaper is caught in the fish’s gill. Its pattern matches the missing person’s bedroom. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭回声浮辉使.zh: 有人试着给它拍照，洗出的纸上只有一块始终不干的水迹。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭回声浮辉使.en: Someone tried to photograph it. The print holds only a patch of water that never dries. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭绒雾裂角客.zh: 它把自己的角锯短了，夜里仍会在门框上留下高处的擦痕。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭绒雾裂角客.en: It has sawn its horns short. At night, fresh scrapes still appear high on the doorframe. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

苔庭镜纹观灯师.zh: 他把静电噪声抄进本子，错别字在第二天都变成了人名。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭镜纹观灯师.en: He copies static into a notebook. By morning, every misspelling has become a person’s name. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭鸣枝缄骨客.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。调查员把它记进了第二份失踪记录。
苔庭鸣枝缄骨客.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. The investigator entered it in the second missing-person report.

苔庭藤印铠卫.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭藤印铠卫.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

苔庭回声枝灯树灵.zh: 枝条钻进密封的档案袋，只在被涂黑的地方重新长出芽。雨停以后，值班室里仍能听到水声。
苔庭回声枝灯树灵.en: A branch enters a sealed evidence bag. Buds grow only over the redacted passages. Water can still be heard in the duty room after the rain stops.

铜钟铠卫领誓·希拉.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟铠卫领誓·希拉.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铠卫领誓·洛拉.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟铠卫领誓·洛拉.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铠卫领誓·米拉.zh: 这名警卫从不摘手套，交回的钥匙却每次都带着新的指纹。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟铠卫领誓·米拉.en: The guard never removes his gloves. The returned keys bear a fresh fingerprint each time. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铠卫领誓·索拉.zh: 巡逻靴始终干净，鞋底夹着的泥却来自一条已经填平的河。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟铠卫领誓·索拉.en: The patrol boots stay clean. Mud caught in the soles comes from a river that was filled in. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟踏铃驹领誓·塔拉.zh: 马鞍下的汗渍呈现出地图，标着一条所有车站都否认的旧路线。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟踏铃驹领誓·塔拉.en: Sweat beneath the saddle forms a map of a route every station denies having served. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟苔脊软虫领誓·莫拉.zh: 它爬过的纸张没有湿，字迹却全都移到了纸的背面。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟苔脊软虫领誓·莫拉.en: The paper it crosses stays dry. Every word has moved to the reverse. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟钩针蝎领誓·图拉.zh: 蝎子的尾刺停在封条上方，封条里的东西也不再响了。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟钩针蝎领誓·图拉.en: The scorpion holds its sting above the seal. Whatever is inside has fallen silent. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟灯议长·芮拉.zh: 他用示波器听取墙内的声音，波形偶尔排成一行可读的字。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟灯议长·芮拉.en: He listens to the wall through an oscilloscope. Sometimes the waveform arranges itself into readable words. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟线尾鼠领誓·艾温.zh: 老鼠把文件边缘啃得很齐，却从来不碰写着姓名的那一栏。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟线尾鼠领誓·艾温.en: The rat trims the file’s edges neatly. It never touches the column containing names. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟线尾鼠领誓·伊温.zh: 它叼走的钥匙都生着旧锈，鼠洞里却总传出开新锁的声音。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟线尾鼠领誓·伊温.en: The keys it steals are rusted. The sound from its hole is always a new lock opening. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟露囊蛙领誓·依温.zh: 蛙卵里浮着细小的黑点，放大后看起来像一排站着的人。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟露囊蛙领誓·依温.en: Dark specks float inside the frogspawn. Enlarged, they resemble a line of standing people. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铠卫领誓·雅温.zh: 他的证件照闭着眼，见到你之后，照片里的眼睛才睁开。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟铠卫领誓·雅温.en: His identification photograph has its eyes shut. They open after he meets you. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟峰脊巨灵领誓·瑟温.zh: 门框上的刻痕一年比一年高，房主却坚持房客从未长大。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟峰脊巨灵领誓·瑟温.en: The marks on the doorframe rise each year. The landlord insists the tenant has never grown. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铠卫领誓·维温.zh: 外套里面缝着许多旧徽章，最靠近心口的一枚没有编号。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟铠卫领誓·维温.en: Old badges line his coat. The one nearest his heart has no number. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铠卫领誓·希温.zh: 他答应守住那扇门，问到里面是什么时，却先看你的背后。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟铠卫领誓·希温.en: He promises to hold the door. Asked what is inside, he looks behind you before answering. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铠卫领誓·米温.zh: 警棍上留着细密的齿印，他说那不是用来打人的一端。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟铠卫领誓·米温.en: Fine tooth marks cover the baton. He says they are on the end he never uses to strike. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟晶棘蜥龙领誓·岚温.zh: 桥下留下成片的鳞屑，最大的一片比失踪车辆的车门还宽。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟晶棘蜥龙领誓·岚温.en: Sheets of scale remain beneath the bridge. The largest is wider than the missing car’s door. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟晶棘蜥龙领誓·索温.zh: 它收拢翅膀时遮住了月亮，水面上却没有多出一块阴影。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟晶棘蜥龙领誓·索温.en: Its folded wings cover the moon. No additional shadow appears on the water. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟缄骨客领誓·莱温.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟缄骨客领誓·莱温.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟浮辉使领誓·岑温.zh: 门禁只记下了一个人的重量，监控里却有两个影子走进来。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟浮辉使领誓·岑温.en: The access sensor recorded one person’s weight. Two shadows enter on the camera feed. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟晶棘蜥龙领誓·塔温.zh: 高处传来巨大的抓挠声，屋顶的灰尘却都从里面向外扬起。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟晶棘蜥龙领誓·塔温.en: Heavy claws scrape overhead. Dust rises from inside the roof and drifts outward. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟灯议长·莫温.zh: 她在空白磁带上做记号，说录音是从擦掉的部分开始的。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟灯议长·莫温.en: She marks a blank tape. She says the recording begins in the part that was erased. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟灯议长·伦温.zh: 他记得你的脸，却坚持你们第一次见面是在明天的停尸房。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟灯议长·伦温.en: He remembers your face. He insists you first met tomorrow, in the morgue. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟裂角客领誓·图温.zh: 额骨撑破了旧帽子的边缘，证件上仍写着一个普通职业。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟裂角客领誓·图温.en: The forehead has split the old cap. The identity card still lists an ordinary occupation. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟镜瞳山猫领誓·芮温.zh: 猫从不碰那只纸箱，夜里却会向箱内一个看不见的东西让路。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟镜瞳山猫领誓·芮温.en: The cat never touches the box. At night it steps aside for something leaving it. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铜缄琉纹铠卫.en: The old armor moves only when the room falls silent, as though someone inside is looking for a way out. Every watch on the street is a breath behind the bell.

铜钟铜缄风蚀铠卫.zh: 他承认曾经离开岗位，却拒绝说明是谁替他签完了整夜。街上所有手表都比钟声慢一次呼吸。
铜钟铜缄风蚀铠卫.en: He admits leaving his post. He will not say who signed the log for the rest of the night. Every watch on the street is a breath behind the bell.

铜钟铜缄静棱铠卫.zh: 值勤腰带少了一样东西，空出来的位置比枪套还要重。街上所有手表都比钟声慢一次呼吸。
铜钟铜缄静棱铠卫.en: Something is missing from the duty belt. The empty space weighs more than the holster. Every watch on the street is a breath behind the bell.

铜钟铜缄绒雾铠卫.zh: 他检查每个人的通行证，轮到自己时，指尖总会停很久。街上所有手表都比钟声慢一次呼吸。
铜钟铜缄绒雾铠卫.en: He checks every pass. When he reaches his own, his fingers remain still for a long time. Every watch on the street is a breath behind the bell.

铜钟铜缄夜航铠卫.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄夜航铠卫.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟回声浮辉使.zh: 有人试着给它拍照，洗出的纸上只有一块始终不干的水迹。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟回声浮辉使.en: Someone tried to photograph it. The print holds only a patch of water that never dries. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟远路观灯师.zh: 仪表没有连电源，他却要求你别在指针停住时看向窗外。街上所有手表都比钟声慢一次呼吸。
铜钟远路观灯师.en: The meter has no power supply. He asks you not to look outside when its needle stops. Every watch on the street is a breath behind the bell.

铜钟流砂缄骨客.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。街上所有手表都比钟声慢一次呼吸。
铜钟流砂缄骨客.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. Every watch on the street is a breath behind the bell.

铜钟铜缄流砂铠卫.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄流砂铠卫.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟铜缄镜纹铠卫.zh: 这名警卫从不摘手套，交回的钥匙却每次都带着新的指纹。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄镜纹铠卫.en: The guard never removes his gloves. The returned keys bear a fresh fingerprint each time. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟铜缄远路铠卫.zh: 巡逻靴始终干净，鞋底夹着的泥却来自一条已经填平的河。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄远路铠卫.en: The patrol boots stay clean. Mud caught in the soles comes from a river that was filled in. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟石封观灯师.zh: 他用示波器听取墙内的声音，波形偶尔排成一行可读的字。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟石封观灯师.en: He listens to the wall through an oscilloscope. Sometimes the waveform arranges itself into readable words. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟铜缄石封铠卫.zh: 他的证件照闭着眼，见到你之后，照片里的眼睛才睁开。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄石封铠卫.en: His identification photograph has its eyes shut. They open after he meets you. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟铜缄鸣枝铠卫.zh: 外套里面缝着许多旧徽章，最靠近心口的一枚没有编号。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄鸣枝铠卫.en: Old badges line his coat. The one nearest his heart has no number. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟铜缄暖灰铠卫.zh: 他答应守住那扇门，问到里面是什么时，却先看你的背后。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄暖灰铠卫.en: He promises to hold the door. Asked what is inside, he looks behind you before answering. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟铜缄悬灯铠卫.zh: 警棍上留着细密的齿印，他说那不是用来打人的一端。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄悬灯铠卫.en: Fine tooth marks cover the baton. He says they are on the end he never uses to strike. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

铜钟苔痕刺灯兽.zh: 刺间粘着医院的细线，轻轻拨动，远处就有人按响呼叫铃。钟楼的值班册少了整整一页星期三。
铜钟苔痕刺灯兽.en: Hospital thread clings between its spines. Touching it makes a call bell ring somewhere far away. A whole Wednesday is missing from the bell tower’s duty book.

铜钟铜缄银露铠卫.zh: 这套旧甲只在无人说话时响动，像有人仍在里面找出口。修表匠不肯说明多出的那根指针。
铜钟铜缄银露铠卫.en: The old armor moves only when the room falls silent, as though someone inside is looking for a way out. The watchmaker refuses to explain the extra hand.

炽砂枝灯树灵领誓·雅弥.zh: 墙内长出的根缠着旧电线，切断电源后仍会轻轻发热。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂枝灯树灵领誓·雅弥.en: Roots inside the wall coil around old wiring. They stay warm after the power is cut. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂裂角客领誓·洛弥.zh: 额骨撑破了旧帽子的边缘，证件上仍写着一个普通职业。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂裂角客领誓·洛弥.en: The forehead has split the old cap. The identity card still lists an ordinary occupation. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂凝光泥团领誓·岚弥.zh: 它在地上留下湿润的轮廓，像一个人曾经在这里躺了很久。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂凝光泥团领誓·岚弥.en: Its damp outline remains on the floor, as if a person lay there for a long time. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂晶棘蜥龙领誓·岑弥.zh: 桥下留下成片的鳞屑，最大的一片比失踪车辆的车门还宽。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂晶棘蜥龙领誓·岑弥.en: Sheets of scale remain beneath the bridge. The largest is wider than the missing car’s door. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫领誓·塔弥.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫领誓·塔弥.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫领誓·佩弥.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫领誓·佩弥.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂晶棘蜥龙领誓·泽弥.zh: 它收拢翅膀时遮住了月亮，水面上却没有多出一块阴影。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂晶棘蜥龙领誓·泽弥.en: Its folded wings cover the moon. No additional shadow appears on the water. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫领誓·阿罗.zh: 这名警卫从不摘手套，交回的钥匙却每次都带着新的指纹。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫领誓·阿罗.en: The guard never removes his gloves. The returned keys bear a fresh fingerprint each time. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂巡影狼领誓·艾罗.zh: 狼群的脚印在路口分开，回到现场时却全都穿过同一张照片。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂巡影狼领誓·艾罗.en: The pack’s tracks divide at the crossing. At the scene, every trail passes through the same photograph. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂峰脊巨灵领誓·欧罗.zh: 门框上的刻痕一年比一年高，房主却坚持房客从未长大。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂峰脊巨灵领誓·欧罗.en: The marks on the doorframe rise each year. The landlord insists the tenant has never grown. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂裂角客领誓·乌罗.zh: 它的影子有两种轮廓，轮到报姓名时，只有其中一个动嘴。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂裂角客领誓·乌罗.en: Its shadow has two outlines. Only one mouth moves when it gives a name. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫领誓·依罗.zh: 巡逻靴始终干净，鞋底夹着的泥却来自一条已经填平的河。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫领誓·依罗.en: The patrol boots stay clean. Mud caught in the soles comes from a river that was filled in. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂修灯师·瑟罗.zh: 防火女把汤盛进铁碗，又塞来一卷蓝线。“衣服破了就补，别连人也扔掉。”她守着冷炉，雨衣袖口一直发烫。你认出线头上的小剪口，和那封早已寄到的信里一模一样。
炽砂修灯师·瑟罗.en: The Fire Warden serves soup in a tin bowl and adds a spool of blue thread. “Mend torn clothes. No need to throw away the person.” She keeps a cold furnace; her raincoat cuffs stay hot. The tiny cut at the thread’s end matches the letter that arrived long ago.

炽砂铠卫·维罗.zh: 他的证件照闭着眼，见到你之后，照片里的眼睛才睁开。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫·维罗.en: His identification photograph has its eyes shut. They open after he meets you. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂巡灯使·希罗.zh: 他记得你的脸，却坚持你们第一次见面是在明天的停尸房。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂巡灯使·希罗.en: He remembers your face. He insists you first met tomorrow, in the morgue. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂巡灯使·洛罗.zh: 她把口供念得很慢，每到自己的名字，窗外就响起刹车声。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂巡灯使·洛罗.en: She reads her statement slowly. Tires screech outside whenever she reaches her name. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂缄骨客·米罗.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂缄骨客·米罗.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂缄骨客·岚罗.zh: 封棺时少了一颗钉子，后来在他的外衣口袋里找到了。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂缄骨客·岚罗.en: A nail was missing when the coffin was sealed. It was later found in his coat pocket. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂潜印客·索罗.zh: 锁没有被撬开的痕迹，屋里却多出一件尺寸合适的雨衣。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂潜印客·索罗.en: The lock shows no damage. A raincoat in exactly the right size has appeared inside. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·莱罗.zh: 外套里面缝着许多旧徽章，最靠近心口的一枚没有编号。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫·莱罗.en: Old badges line his coat. The one nearest his heart has no number. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·岑罗.zh: 他答应守住那扇门，问到里面是什么时，却先看你的背后。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫·岑罗.en: He promises to hold the door. Asked what is inside, he looks behind you before answering. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·塔罗.zh: 警棍上留着细密的齿印，他说那不是用来打人的一端。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫·塔罗.en: Fine tooth marks cover the baton. He says they are on the end he never uses to strike. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂潜印客·莫罗.zh: 他收走你的照片，只归还底片，说照片会替别人认出你。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂潜印客·莫罗.en: He takes your photograph and returns only the negative. He says a print lets someone else recognize you. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·伦罗.zh: 这套旧甲只在无人说话时响动，像有人仍在里面找出口。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫·伦罗.en: The old armor moves only when the room falls silent, as though someone inside is looking for a way out. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂潜印客·佩罗.zh: 她会替人藏起证词，但每份副本都在最不该出现的地方找到。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂潜印客·佩罗.en: She hides statements for people. Every copy is found where it ought least to be. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂巡灯使·泽罗.zh: 这名乘客一直握着空票夹，说目的地写在车站的另一面。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂巡灯使·泽罗.en: The passenger holds an empty ticket wallet. He says the destination is on the other side of the station. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂修灯师·图罗.zh: 这名医师听诊很久，最后问你有没有梦见另一个心跳声。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂修灯师·图罗.en: The physician listens for a long time, then asks whether you have dreamed of a second heartbeat. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·芮罗.zh: 他承认曾经离开岗位，却拒绝说明是谁替他签完了整夜。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫·芮罗.en: He admits leaving his post. He will not say who signed the log for the rest of the night. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂观灯师·阿安.zh: 他用示波器听取墙内的声音，波形偶尔排成一行可读的字。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂观灯师·阿安.en: He listens to the wall through an oscilloscope. Sometimes the waveform arranges itself into readable words. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂观灯师·艾安.zh: 她在空白磁带上做记号，说录音是从擦掉的部分开始的。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂观灯师·艾安.en: She marks a blank tape. She says the recording begins in the part that was erased. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂观灯师·伊安.zh: 他的测绘纸只画房间内侧，折起之后，外面便多出一扇门。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂观灯师·伊安.en: His survey shows only the inside of the room. Folded shut, it leaves an extra door outside. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂潜印客·欧安.zh: 他从不走有脚印的那条路，仍会在转角撞见自己的背影。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂潜印客·欧安.en: He avoids paths with footprints. At the next corner he still finds his own back. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂观灯师·乌安.zh: 她念出一串没人接听的号码，停电的屋子逐间亮起了灯。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂观灯师·乌安.en: She recites numbers nobody answers. Lights come on one by one in houses without power. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·依安.zh: 值勤腰带少了一样东西，空出来的位置比枪套还要重。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫·依安.en: Something is missing from the duty belt. The empty space weighs more than the holster. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·雅安.zh: 他检查每个人的通行证，轮到自己时，指尖总会停很久。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铠卫·雅安.en: He checks every pass. When he reaches his own, his fingers remain still for a long time. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂修灯师·诺安.zh: 她认得每个人的伤痕，却说不清这些记录是哪一次看诊写的。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂修灯师·诺安.en: She knows every scar. She cannot say which consultation produced the notes. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂潜印客·瑟安.zh: 她的口袋里没有钥匙，所有钥匙的编号却记在皮肤下面。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂潜印客·瑟安.en: There are no keys in her pockets. Their numbers can be read beneath her skin. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·维安.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铠卫·维安.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂巡灯使·希安.zh: 他来报失踪，拿出的照片是自己，背面写着尚未发生的事。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂巡灯使·希安.en: He comes to report a disappearance. The photograph is his own, with events that have not happened written on the back. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铠卫·洛安.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铠卫·洛安.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铠卫·米安.zh: 这名警卫从不摘手套，交回的钥匙却每次都带着新的指纹。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铠卫·米安.en: The guard never removes his gloves. The returned keys bear a fresh fingerprint each time. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂微烛缄骨客.zh: 它的牙齿已经不齐，录音里的齿音却清楚得像贴着话筒。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂微烛缄骨客.en: Its teeth are incomplete. The sibilants on the tape sound as if its mouth is pressed to the microphone. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂琉纹缄骨客.zh: 他记得被埋在哪里，却总把回家的路说成另一座墓的地址。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂琉纹缄骨客.en: He remembers where he was buried. His directions home always end at another grave. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂苔痕环藤蛇.zh: 蛇蜕从锁孔里拖出来，里面还包着一张没有签名的借条。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕环藤蛇.en: A shed snakeskin trails from the keyhole, wrapped around an unsigned note of debt. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂苔痕棱耳猎犬.zh: 狗把鼻尖贴在空白相片上，随后一直等在没有门的那面墙前。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕棱耳猎犬.en: The dog presses its nose to a blank photograph, then waits beside the wall without a door. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄铜缄铠卫.zh: 巡逻靴始终干净，鞋底夹着的泥却来自一条已经填平的河。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄铜缄铠卫.en: The patrol boots stay clean. Mud caught in the soles comes from a river that was filled in. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铜缄回声铠卫.zh: 他的证件照闭着眼，见到你之后，照片里的眼睛才睁开。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄回声铠卫.en: His identification photograph has its eyes shut. They open after he meets you. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铜缄微烛铠卫.zh: 外套里面缝着许多旧徽章，最靠近心口的一枚没有编号。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄微烛铠卫.en: Old badges line his coat. The one nearest his heart has no number. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铜缄琉纹铠卫.zh: 他答应守住那扇门，问到里面是什么时，却先看你的背后。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄琉纹铠卫.en: He promises to hold the door. Asked what is inside, he looks behind you before answering. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铜缄风蚀铠卫.zh: 警棍上留着细密的齿印，他说那不是用来打人的一端。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄风蚀铠卫.en: Fine tooth marks cover the baton. He says they are on the end he never uses to strike. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂琉纹修灯师.zh: 药瓶上的日期早已过期，瓶内的标签却写着下周的天气。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂琉纹修灯师.en: The medicine has expired. A label inside the bottle gives next week’s weather. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂风蚀缄骨客.zh: 这具身体的旧伤都合上了，缝线却在向皮肤外缓慢生长。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂风蚀缄骨客.en: The body’s old wounds have closed. The sutures are slowly growing out through the skin. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂静棱缄骨客.zh: 它不追赶活人，只会跟着那些已经登记过死亡的姓名走。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂静棱缄骨客.en: It does not pursue the living. It follows names that have already been entered in the death register. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂回声裂角客.zh: 他不肯越过地面的盐线，盐粒却在你眨眼时排到了门外。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂回声裂角客.en: He will not cross the line of salt. Between blinks, the grains rearrange themselves outside the door. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂绒雾缄骨客.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂绒雾缄骨客.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂夜航缄骨客.zh: 封棺时少了一颗钉子，后来在他的外衣口袋里找到了。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂夜航缄骨客.en: A nail was missing when the coffin was sealed. It was later found in his coat pocket. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂苔痕掠风鸟.zh: 这只鸟学会了电话的铃声，来电记录却总是在它叫过后才出现。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕掠风鸟.en: The bird has learned a telephone’s ring. The call appears in the log only after it cries. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄掠风鸟.zh: 鸦羽粘在没有开启过的窗缝，羽轴上刻着很小的门牌号码。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铜缄掠风鸟.en: Raven feathers cling to a window that has never opened. Tiny street numbers mark their shafts. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄巡影狼.zh: 它嗅过你的袖口便停止低吼，像认出了一个不该在这里的人。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铜缄巡影狼.en: It stops growling after smelling your sleeve, as if recognizing someone who should not be here. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄静棱铠卫.zh: 这套旧甲只在无人说话时响动，像有人仍在里面找出口。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄静棱铠卫.en: The old armor moves only when the room falls silent, as though someone inside is looking for a way out. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铜缄绒雾铠卫.zh: 他承认曾经离开岗位，却拒绝说明是谁替他签完了整夜。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄绒雾铠卫.en: He admits leaving his post. He will not say who signed the log for the rest of the night. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂苔痕砂脊蜥.zh: 蜥蜴的尾巴留在证物盘里，身体却每天回来替它换一个位置。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕砂脊蜥.en: The lizard’s tail lies in an evidence tray. Its body returns each day to move it. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄砂脊蜥.zh: 鳞片下映出缓慢转动的刻度，靠近时才发现刻度写着人名。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铜缄砂脊蜥.en: Scales reveal a slowly turning dial beneath. Up close, its marks turn out to be names. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂风蚀修灯师.zh: 他让你握住一盏检查灯，自己的影子却留在手术台上不动。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂风蚀修灯师.en: He asks you to hold the examination lamp. His shadow remains motionless on the operating table. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄夜航铠卫.zh: 值勤腰带少了一样东西，空出来的位置比枪套还要重。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄夜航铠卫.en: Something is missing from the duty belt. The empty space weighs more than the holster. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂回声峰脊巨灵.zh: 它坐过的椅子没有断，地基却像被什么东西往下按了一寸。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂回声峰脊巨灵.en: The chair it sat on remains intact. The foundation looks as if something pressed it an inch lower. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂流砂缄骨客.zh: 它的牙齿已经不齐，录音里的齿音却清楚得像贴着话筒。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂流砂缄骨客.en: Its teeth are incomplete. The sibilants on the tape sound as if its mouth is pressed to the microphone. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂苔痕匣中客.zh: 这只箱子贴着失物招领的标签，里面的牙齿却都刻着领取日期。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕匣中客.en: The box bears a lost-property label. Every tooth inside is marked with a collection date. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂镜纹缄骨客.zh: 他记得被埋在哪里，却总把回家的路说成另一座墓的地址。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂镜纹缄骨客.en: He remembers where he was buried. His directions home always end at another grave. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铜缄流砂铠卫.zh: 他检查每个人的通行证，轮到自己时，指尖总会停很久。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂铜缄流砂铠卫.en: He checks every pass. When he reaches his own, his fingers remain still for a long time. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂远路缄骨客.zh: 这具身体的旧伤都合上了，缝线却在向皮肤外缓慢生长。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂远路缄骨客.en: The body’s old wounds have closed. The sutures are slowly growing out through the skin. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂石封缄骨客.zh: 它不追赶活人，只会跟着那些已经登记过死亡的姓名走。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂石封缄骨客.en: It does not pursue the living. It follows names that have already been entered in the death register. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂苔痕铜壳蟹.zh: 蟹钳夹着一段门链，锈蚀的位置与案卷里的断口正好吻合。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕铜壳蟹.en: The crab grips a door chain. The corroded break matches the one in the case file. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂微烛裂角客.zh: 窗玻璃映出弯曲的角，站在玻璃前的人却戴着平整的帽子。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂微烛裂角客.en: Curved horns appear in the window. The person standing before it wears an undamaged hat. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂静棱修灯师.zh: 她给伤口换上新的绷带，拆下来的旧布里却没有一点血。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂静棱修灯师.en: She changes the dressing. There is no blood anywhere in the cloth she removes. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂苔痕地缝蠕虫.zh: 虫身里能看见吞下的纸条，上面的字朝着相反方向缓慢爬动。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕地缝蠕虫.en: A swallowed note shows through the worm’s body. Its letters move slowly in the opposite direction. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄镜纹铠卫.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄镜纹铠卫.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂静棱观灯师.zh: 他把静电噪声抄进本子，错别字在第二天都变成了人名。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂静棱观灯师.en: He copies static into a notebook. By morning, every misspelling has become a person’s name. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄远路铠卫.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄远路铠卫.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂铜缄石封铠卫.zh: 这名警卫从不摘手套，交回的钥匙却每次都带着新的指纹。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄石封铠卫.en: The guard never removes his gloves. The returned keys bear a fresh fingerprint each time. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂鸣枝缄骨客.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂鸣枝缄骨客.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂回声巡影狼.zh: 这头狼只对着空座位露齿，座位上的安全带却一直系着。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂回声巡影狼.en: The wolf bares its teeth at an empty seat. The seat belt remains fastened. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂夜航巡灯使.zh: 她拒绝进入镜头，只愿站在照片已经被裁掉的那个位置。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂夜航巡灯使.en: She refuses to enter the frame. She will stand only where the photograph has already been cropped. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂苔痕折面星客.zh: 它照着录音学会了敲门，敲击之间却没有留给人开门的时间。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕折面星客.en: It learned to knock from a recording. The intervals leave nobody time to open the door. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂琉纹裂角客.zh: 它把自己的角锯短了，夜里仍会在门框上留下高处的擦痕。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂琉纹裂角客.en: It has sawn its horns short. At night, fresh scrapes still appear high on the doorframe. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂苔痕石指傀儡.zh: 这只手保留着完整的指纹，却没有任何一枚指甲长在正面。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕石指傀儡.en: The hand retains every fingerprint. None of its nails grows on the front. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂铜缄环藤蛇.zh: 它盘着一只早已停走的表，表针却一直跟着鳞片慢慢移动。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铜缄环藤蛇.en: It coils around a stopped watch. The hands keep moving with the scales. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂回声环藤蛇.zh: 水管里传来吐信声，维修图上却没有画出这条管道。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂回声环藤蛇.en: A tongue flicks inside the pipe. The maintenance plan shows no pipe in that position. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂微烛环藤蛇.zh: 蛇蜕从锁孔里拖出来，里面还包着一张没有签名的借条。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂微烛环藤蛇.en: A shed snakeskin trails from the keyhole, wrapped around an unsigned note of debt. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂回声砂脊蜥.zh: 蜥蜴的尾巴留在证物盘里，身体却每天回来替它换一个位置。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂回声砂脊蜥.en: The lizard’s tail lies in an evidence tray. Its body returns each day to move it. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铜缄鸣枝铠卫.zh: 巡逻靴始终干净，鞋底夹着的泥却来自一条已经填平的河。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄鸣枝铠卫.en: The patrol boots stay clean. Mud caught in the soles comes from a river that was filled in. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂铜缄暖灰铠卫.zh: 他的证件照闭着眼，见到你之后，照片里的眼睛才睁开。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄暖灰铠卫.en: His identification photograph has its eyes shut. They open after he meets you. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂铜缄悬灯铠卫.zh: 外套里面缝着许多旧徽章，最靠近心口的一枚没有编号。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄悬灯铠卫.en: Old badges line his coat. The one nearest his heart has no number. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂铜缄银露铠卫.zh: 他答应守住那扇门，问到里面是什么时，却先看你的背后。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄银露铠卫.en: He promises to hold the door. Asked what is inside, he looks behind you before answering. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂铜缄枝灯树灵.zh: 叶脉像一张熟悉的街区图，缺的那条巷子从来没有人走出来。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂铜缄枝灯树灵.en: The leaf veins resemble a familiar street map. Nobody has ever returned from the missing lane. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂微烛巡影狼.zh: 狼群的脚印在路口分开，回到现场时却全都穿过同一张照片。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂微烛巡影狼.en: The pack’s tracks divide at the crossing. At the scene, every trail passes through the same photograph. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂铜缄藤印铠卫.zh: 警棍上留着细密的齿印，他说那不是用来打人的一端。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄藤印铠卫.en: Fine tooth marks cover the baton. He says they are on the end he never uses to strike. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂铜缄雾羽铠卫.zh: 这套旧甲只在无人说话时响动，像有人仍在里面找出口。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄雾羽铠卫.en: The old armor moves only when the room falls silent, as though someone inside is looking for a way out. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂铜缄弧光铠卫.zh: 他承认曾经离开岗位，却拒绝说明是谁替他签完了整夜。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铜缄弧光铠卫.en: He admits leaving his post. He will not say who signed the log for the rest of the night. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂苔痕甲灯虫.zh: 虫翅沾着洗印药水，飞行时在灯下抖出一小串褪色的人脸。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕甲灯虫.en: Photographic chemicals stain its wings. Faces shake loose beneath the lamp when it flies. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂绒雾修灯师.zh: 这名医师听诊很久，最后问你有没有梦见另一个心跳声。炉子停了，排班表却还在增加人名。
炽砂绒雾修灯师.en: The physician listens for a long time, then asks whether you have dreamed of a second heartbeat. The furnaces have stopped. Names keep appearing on the shift sheet.

炽砂苔痕绛纹蝶.zh: 蝶翼的斑纹像两张侧脸，停下来时，总有一张背向光线。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕绛纹蝶.en: The wing patterns resemble two faces in profile. Whenever it rests, one turns away from the light. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂苔痕露囊蛙.zh: 蛙卵里浮着细小的黑点，放大后看起来像一排站着的人。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂苔痕露囊蛙.en: Dark specks float inside the frogspawn. Enlarged, they resemble a line of standing people. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

炽砂暖灰缄骨客.zh: 封棺时少了一颗钉子，后来在他的外衣口袋里找到了。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂暖灰缄骨客.en: A nail was missing when the coffin was sealed. It was later found in his coat pocket. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂微烛峰脊巨灵.zh: 他只需伸手就能碰到屋顶，却低头说自己被关在很小的地方。灰厂的打卡钟打印着明天的日期。
炽砂微烛峰脊巨灵.en: He can touch the roof without standing. Looking down, he says he is confined somewhere very small. The time clock at the Ash Works prints tomorrow’s date.

苔庭铠卫·岚安.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。镇上的住户都说那晚没有起雾。
苔庭铠卫·岚安.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. Every resident insists there was no fog that night.

铜钟缄骨客·索安.zh: 封棺时少了一颗钉子，后来在他的外衣口袋里找到了。街上所有手表都比钟声慢一次呼吸。
铜钟缄骨客·索安.en: A nail was missing when the coffin was sealed. It was later found in his coat pocket. Every watch on the street is a breath behind the bell.

炽砂回声苔痕铠卫.zh: 值勤腰带少了一样东西，空出来的位置比枪套还要重。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂回声苔痕铠卫.en: Something is missing from the duty belt. The empty space weighs more than the holster. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

炽砂铠卫·莱安.zh: 他检查每个人的通行证，轮到自己时，指尖总会停很久。那台机器的说明书只有倒数第二页。
炽砂铠卫·莱安.en: He checks every pass. When he reaches his own, his fingers remain still for a long time. Only the penultimate page of the machine’s manual remains.

砂镜凝光泥团领誓·岑安.zh: 它在地上留下湿润的轮廓，像一个人曾经在这里躺了很久。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜凝光泥团领誓·岑安.en: Its damp outline remains on the floor, as if a person lay there for a long time. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫领誓·塔安.zh: 阿奇，档案称“复卷守备”。护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫领誓·塔安.en: Archie, filed as Refolded Sentry. Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫领誓·莫安.zh: 沃尔特，档案称“旧印门卫”。他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫领誓·莫安.en: Walter, filed as Oldseal Keeper. He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜裂角客领誓·伦安.zh: 额骨撑破了旧帽子的边缘，证件上仍写着一个普通职业。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜裂角客领誓·伦安.en: The forehead has split the old cap. The identity card still lists an ordinary occupation. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜峰脊巨灵领誓·佩安.zh: 门框上的刻痕一年比一年高，房主却坚持房客从未长大。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜峰脊巨灵领誓·佩安.en: The marks on the doorframe rise each year. The landlord insists the tenant has never grown. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜裂角客领誓·泽安.zh: 它的影子有两种轮廓，轮到报姓名时，只有其中一个动嘴。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜裂角客领誓·泽安.en: Its shadow has two outlines. Only one mouth moves when it gives a name. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫领誓·图安.zh: 这名警卫从不摘手套，交回的钥匙却每次都带着新的指纹。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫领誓·图安.en: The guard never removes his gloves. The returned keys bear a fresh fingerprint each time. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜凝光泥团领誓·芮安.zh: 玻璃后面的黏液跟着问话缓慢起伏，没人记录它答了什么。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜凝光泥团领誓·芮安.en: The substance behind the glass rises and falls with the questions. Nobody records its answers. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜织光蛛领誓·阿瑟.zh: 伊迪丝，档案称“盲档蛛”。蛛网没有粘住飞虫，空出的结点却对应着几处失踪者的住址。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜织光蛛领誓·阿瑟.en: Edith, filed as Blinddoc Spider. No insects are caught in the web. Its empty junctions correspond to missing persons’ addresses. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜裂角客领誓·艾瑟.zh: 他不肯越过地面的盐线，盐粒却在你眨眼时排到了门外。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜裂角客领誓·艾瑟.en: He will not cross the line of salt. Between blinks, the grains rearrange themselves outside the door. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜晶棘蜥龙领誓·伊瑟.zh: 桥下留下成片的鳞屑，最大的一片比失踪车辆的车门还宽。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜晶棘蜥龙领誓·伊瑟.en: Sheets of scale remain beneath the bridge. The largest is wider than the missing car’s door. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜灯议长·欧瑟.zh: 他用示波器听取墙内的声音，波形偶尔排成一行可读的字。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜灯议长·欧瑟.en: He listens to the wall through an oscilloscope. Sometimes the waveform arranges itself into readable words. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜灯议长·乌瑟.zh: 她在空白磁带上做记号，说录音是从擦掉的部分开始的。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜灯议长·乌瑟.en: She marks a blank tape. She says the recording begins in the part that was erased. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜潮纹游鱼领誓·依瑟.zh: 珀西，档案称“漏页鱼”。鱼鳃里夹着一小块墙纸，花纹与失踪者卧室的照片相同。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜潮纹游鱼领誓·依瑟.en: Percy, filed as Leafless Fish. A scrap of wallpaper is caught in the fish’s gill. Its pattern matches the missing person’s bedroom. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜峰脊巨灵领誓·雅瑟.zh: 它坐过的椅子没有断，地基却像被什么东西往下按了一寸。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜峰脊巨灵领誓·雅瑟.en: The chair it sat on remains intact. The foundation looks as if something pressed it an inch lower. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜地缝蠕虫领誓·诺瑟.zh: 虫身里能看见吞下的纸条，上面的字朝着相反方向缓慢爬动。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜地缝蠕虫领誓·诺瑟.en: A swallowed note shows through the worm’s body. Its letters move slowly in the opposite direction. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜峰脊巨灵领誓·瑟瑟.zh: 他只需伸手就能碰到屋顶，却低头说自己被关在很小的地方。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜峰脊巨灵领誓·瑟瑟.en: He can touch the roof without standing. Looking down, he says he is confined somewhere very small. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜灯议长·维瑟.zh: 奥斯卡，档案称“无字药师”。她给伤口换上新的绷带，拆下来的旧布里却没有一点血。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜灯议长·维瑟.en: Oscar, filed as Wordless Chemist. She changes the dressing. There is no blood anywhere in the cloth she removes. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜修灯师·希瑟.zh: 这名医师听诊很久，最后问你有没有梦见另一个心跳声。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜修灯师·希瑟.en: The physician listens for a long time, then asks whether you have dreamed of a second heartbeat. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜浮辉使·洛瑟.zh: 门禁只记下了一个人的重量，监控里却有两个影子走进来。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜浮辉使·洛瑟.en: The access sensor recorded one person’s weight. Two shadows enter on the camera feed. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜修灯师·米瑟.zh: 她认得每个人的伤痕，却说不清这些记录是哪一次看诊写的。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜修灯师·米瑟.en: She knows every scar. She cannot say which consultation produced the notes. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜修灯师·岚瑟.zh: 药瓶上的日期早已过期，瓶内的标签却写着下周的天气。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜修灯师·岚瑟.en: The medicine has expired. A label inside the bottle gives next week’s weather. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫·索瑟.zh: 巡逻靴始终干净，鞋底夹着的泥却来自一条已经填平的河。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫·索瑟.en: The patrol boots stay clean. Mud caught in the soles comes from a river that was filled in. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫·莱瑟.zh: 他的证件照闭着眼，见到你之后，照片里的眼睛才睁开。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫·莱瑟.en: His identification photograph has its eyes shut. They open after he meets you. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·岑瑟.zh: 他记得你的脸，却坚持你们第一次见面是在明天的停尸房。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·岑瑟.en: He remembers your face. He insists you first met tomorrow, in the morgue. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·塔瑟.zh: 她把口供念得很慢，每到自己的名字，窗外就响起刹车声。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·塔瑟.en: She reads her statement slowly. Tires screech outside whenever she reaches her name. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·莫瑟.zh: 这名乘客一直握着空票夹，说目的地写在车站的另一面。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·莫瑟.en: The passenger holds an empty ticket wallet. He says the destination is on the other side of the station. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫·伦瑟.zh: 外套里面缝着许多旧徽章，最靠近心口的一枚没有编号。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫·伦瑟.en: Old badges line his coat. The one nearest his heart has no number. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫·佩瑟.zh: 他答应守住那扇门，问到里面是什么时，却先看你的背后。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫·佩瑟.en: He promises to hold the door. Asked what is inside, he looks behind you before answering. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫·泽瑟.zh: 警棍上留着细密的齿印，他说那不是用来打人的一端。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫·泽瑟.en: Fine tooth marks cover the baton. He says they are on the end he never uses to strike. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫·图瑟.zh: 这套旧甲只在无人说话时响动，像有人仍在里面找出口。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫·图瑟.en: The old armor moves only when the room falls silent, as though someone inside is looking for a way out. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·芮瑟.zh: 他来报失踪，拿出的照片是自己，背面写着尚未发生的事。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·芮瑟.en: He comes to report a disappearance. The photograph is his own, with events that have not happened written on the back. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·阿尘.zh: 她拒绝进入镜头，只愿站在照片已经被裁掉的那个位置。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·阿尘.en: She refuses to enter the frame. She will stand only where the photograph has already been cropped. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铠卫·艾尘.zh: 他承认曾经离开岗位，却拒绝说明是谁替他签完了整夜。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铠卫·艾尘.en: He admits leaving his post. He will not say who signed the log for the rest of the night. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜潜印客·伊尘.zh: 锁没有被撬开的痕迹，屋里却多出一件尺寸合适的雨衣。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜潜印客·伊尘.en: The lock shows no damage. A raincoat in exactly the right size has appeared inside. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·欧尘.zh: 他没有说谎，录音里的回答却总比你提出问题早半拍。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·欧尘.en: He is not lying. On the recording, his answers arrive a fraction before your questions. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·乌尘.zh: 她认得每条街，唯独说不出自己那栋房子白天在哪里。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·乌尘.en: She knows every street. She cannot say where her house goes during the day. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·依尘.zh: 他把收据按日期排好，最旧的一张仍带着你掌心的温度。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·依尘.en: He sorts the receipts by date. The oldest still carries the warmth of your hand. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·雅尘.zh: 电话接通后，他只听不说，隔壁房间却传来同样的呼吸。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·雅尘.en: He listens without speaking when the call connects. The same breathing comes from the next room. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜掠风鸟·诺尘.zh: 这只鸟学会了电话的铃声，来电记录却总是在它叫过后才出现。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜掠风鸟·诺尘.en: The bird has learned a telephone’s ring. The call appears in the log only after it cries. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜潜印客·瑟尘.zh: 他收走你的照片，只归还底片，说照片会替别人认出你。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜潜印客·瑟尘.en: He takes your photograph and returns only the negative. He says a print lets someone else recognize you. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜潜印客·维尘.zh: 她会替人藏起证词，但每份副本都在最不该出现的地方找到。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜潜印客·维尘.en: She hides statements for people. Every copy is found where it ought least to be. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜观灯师·希尘.zh: 他的测绘纸只画房间内侧，折起之后，外面便多出一扇门。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜观灯师·希尘.en: His survey shows only the inside of the room. Folded shut, it leaves an extra door outside. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜观灯师·洛尘.zh: 她念出一串没人接听的号码，停电的屋子逐间亮起了灯。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜观灯师·洛尘.en: She recites numbers nobody answers. Lights come on one by one in houses without power. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜观灯师·米尘.zh: 他把静电噪声抄进本子，错别字在第二天都变成了人名。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜观灯师·米尘.en: He copies static into a notebook. By morning, every misspelling has become a person’s name. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜观灯师·岚尘.zh: 仪表没有连电源，他却要求你别在指针停住时看向窗外。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜观灯师·岚尘.en: The meter has no power supply. He asks you not to look outside when its needle stops. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜巡灯使·索尘.zh: 她说自己来认领遗物，清单上每一样东西都还在你身上。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜巡灯使·索尘.en: She has come to collect personal effects. Every item on the list is still on your person. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜镜纹铠卫.zh: 值勤腰带少了一样东西，空出来的位置比枪套还要重。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜镜纹铠卫.en: Something is missing from the duty belt. The empty space weighs more than the holster. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜远路铠卫.zh: 他检查每个人的通行证，轮到自己时，指尖总会停很久。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜远路铠卫.en: He checks every pass. When he reaches his own, his fingers remain still for a long time. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜苔痕缄骨客.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜苔痕缄骨客.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜苔痕棱耳猎犬.zh: 狗把鼻尖贴在空白相片上，随后一直等在没有门的那面墙前。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜苔痕棱耳猎犬.en: The dog presses its nose to a blank photograph, then waits beside the wall without a door. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜镜纹巡灯使.zh: 他不肯在口供上落款，纸张下方却慢慢浮出一笔熟悉的字。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜镜纹巡灯使.en: He will not sign the statement. Familiar handwriting slowly appears at the foot of the page. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铜缄缄骨客.zh: 封棺时少了一颗钉子，后来在他的外衣口袋里找到了。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铜缄缄骨客.en: A nail was missing when the coffin was sealed. It was later found in his coat pocket. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜回声缄骨客.zh: 它的牙齿已经不齐，录音里的齿音却清楚得像贴着话筒。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜回声缄骨客.en: Its teeth are incomplete. The sibilants on the tape sound as if its mouth is pressed to the microphone. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜苔痕甲灯虫.zh: 虫翅沾着洗印药水，飞行时在灯下抖出一小串褪色的人脸。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜苔痕甲灯虫.en: Photographic chemicals stain its wings. Faces shake loose beneath the lamp when it flies. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜回声凝光泥团.zh: 证物箱里没有漏水，它却不断增加，逼得标签向外翘起。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜回声凝光泥团.en: The evidence box is not leaking. The mass inside keeps growing, lifting the label at its edges. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜苔痕砂脊蜥.zh: 蜥蜴的尾巴留在证物盘里，身体却每天回来替它换一个位置。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜苔痕砂脊蜥.en: The lizard’s tail lies in an evidence tray. Its body returns each day to move it. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铜缄地缝蠕虫.zh: 它沿着地缝前行，身后露出的砖面比房屋本身更陈旧。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铜缄地缝蠕虫.en: It follows the crack in the floor, exposing brickwork older than the house. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铜缄浮辉使.zh: 它站在被擦掉的名字旁边，像还在等谁补上最后一笔。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铜缄浮辉使.en: It stands beside the erased name, as though waiting for someone to finish the final stroke. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜微烛裂角客.zh: 窗玻璃映出弯曲的角，站在玻璃前的人却戴着平整的帽子。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜微烛裂角客.en: Curved horns appear in the window. The person standing before it wears an undamaged hat. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铜缄潮纹游鱼.zh: 它游过水下的窗户，玻璃里映出的却是一条干燥的走廊。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铜缄潮纹游鱼.en: It swims past a submerged window. The reflection shows a dry corridor. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜微烛缄骨客.zh: 他记得被埋在哪里，却总把回家的路说成另一座墓的地址。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜微烛缄骨客.en: He remembers where he was buried. His directions home always end at another grave. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜苔痕苔脊软虫.zh: 它爬过的纸张没有湿，字迹却全都移到了纸的背面。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜苔痕苔脊软虫.en: The paper it crosses stays dry. Every word has moved to the reverse. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜苔痕线尾鼠.zh: 老鼠把文件边缘啃得很齐，却从来不碰写着姓名的那一栏。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜苔痕线尾鼠.en: The rat trims the file’s edges neatly. It never touches the column containing names. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜铜缄甲灯虫.zh: 它只撞那只没有通电的灯泡，灯丝却在撞击后变得更亮。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铜缄甲灯虫.en: It strikes only the unpowered bulb. The filament brightens after each impact. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜石封铠卫.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。空出的案卷位置已经积了很厚的灰。
砂镜石封铠卫.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. Thick dust fills the space where the file should be.

砂镜鸣枝铠卫.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。空出的案卷位置已经积了很厚的灰。
砂镜鸣枝铠卫.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. Thick dust fills the space where the file should be.

砂镜微烛潜印客.zh: 他从不走有脚印的那条路，仍会在转角撞见自己的背影。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜微烛潜印客.en: He avoids paths with footprints. At the next corner he still finds his own back. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜琉纹缄骨客.zh: 这具身体的旧伤都合上了，缝线却在向皮肤外缓慢生长。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜琉纹缄骨客.en: The body’s old wounds have closed. The sutures are slowly growing out through the skin. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜风蚀缄骨客.zh: 它不追赶活人，只会跟着那些已经登记过死亡的姓名走。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜风蚀缄骨客.en: It does not pursue the living. It follows names that have already been entered in the death register. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜静棱缄骨客.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。空出的案卷位置已经积了很厚的灰。
砂镜静棱缄骨客.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. Thick dust fills the space where the file should be.

砂镜微烛峰脊巨灵.zh: 这名搬运工搬得动整台锅炉，却从不碰那只没有上锁的箱子。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜微烛峰脊巨灵.en: The porter can move a whole boiler. He will not touch the unlocked box beside it. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜苔痕折面星客.zh: 它照着录音学会了敲门，敲击之间却没有留给人开门的时间。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜苔痕折面星客.en: It learned to knock from a recording. The intervals leave nobody time to open the door. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜静棱观灯师.zh: 他用示波器听取墙内的声音，波形偶尔排成一行可读的字。空出的案卷位置已经积了很厚的灰。
砂镜静棱观灯师.en: He listens to the wall through an oscilloscope. Sometimes the waveform arranges itself into readable words. Thick dust fills the space where the file should be.

砂镜绒雾观灯师.zh: 她在空白磁带上做记号，说录音是从擦掉的部分开始的。空出的案卷位置已经积了很厚的灰。
砂镜绒雾观灯师.en: She marks a blank tape. She says the recording begins in the part that was erased. Thick dust fills the space where the file should be.

砂镜铜缄晶棘蜥龙.zh: 它收拢翅膀时遮住了月亮，水面上却没有多出一块阴影。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜铜缄晶棘蜥龙.en: Its folded wings cover the moon. No additional shadow appears on the water. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

砂镜回声晶棘蜥龙.zh: 高处传来巨大的抓挠声，屋顶的灰尘却都从里面向外扬起。档案室保存着这份证词的另一种结局。
砂镜回声晶棘蜥龙.en: Heavy claws scrape overhead. Dust rises from inside the roof and drifts outward. The archive holds another ending to the same statement.

暮潮缄骨客领誓·芮尘.zh: 尸检记录写着肺部没有空气，他却能一口气讲完那晚的事。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮缄骨客领誓·芮尘.en: The autopsy lists no air in his lungs. He tells the whole night’s story without pausing for breath. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮折面星客领誓·伊汀.zh: 它照着录音学会了敲门，敲击之间却没有留给人开门的时间。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮折面星客领誓·伊汀.en: It learned to knock from a recording. The intervals leave nobody time to open the door. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮折面星客领誓·欧汀.zh: 照片中的五官都在正确位置，合在一起却无法让人记住。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮折面星客领誓·欧汀.en: Every feature occupies the right place in the photograph. Together, they cannot be remembered. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮折面星客领誓·瑟汀.zh: 它认真模仿呼吸，等你屏住气时，整个房间才跟着安静下来。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮折面星客领誓·瑟汀.en: It carefully imitates breathing. When you hold yours, the whole room becomes quiet. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮灯议长·洛汀.zh: 他记得你的脸，却坚持你们第一次见面是在明天的停尸房。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮灯议长·洛汀.en: He remembers your face. He insists you first met tomorrow, in the morgue. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮灯议长·米汀.zh: 她把口供念得很慢，每到自己的名字，窗外就响起刹车声。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮灯议长·米汀.en: She reads her statement slowly. Tires screech outside whenever she reaches her name. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮灯议长·岚汀.zh: 他用示波器听取墙内的声音，波形偶尔排成一行可读的字。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮灯议长·岚汀.en: He listens to the wall through an oscilloscope. Sometimes the waveform arranges itself into readable words. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮峰脊巨灵领誓·索汀.zh: 门框上的刻痕一年比一年高，房主却坚持房客从未长大。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮峰脊巨灵领誓·索汀.en: The marks on the doorframe rise each year. The landlord insists the tenant has never grown. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮裂角客领誓·莱汀.zh: 额骨撑破了旧帽子的边缘，证件上仍写着一个普通职业。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮裂角客领誓·莱汀.en: The forehead has split the old cap. The identity card still lists an ordinary occupation. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮地缝蠕虫领誓·岑汀.zh: 虫身里能看见吞下的纸条，上面的字朝着相反方向缓慢爬动。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮地缝蠕虫领誓·岑汀.en: A swallowed note shows through the worm’s body. Its letters move slowly in the opposite direction. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮棱耳猎犬领誓·塔汀.zh: 狗把鼻尖贴在空白相片上，随后一直等在没有门的那面墙前。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮棱耳猎犬领誓·塔汀.en: The dog presses its nose to a blank photograph, then waits beside the wall without a door. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮缄骨客领誓·莫汀.zh: 封棺时少了一颗钉子，后来在他的外衣口袋里找到了。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮缄骨客领誓·莫汀.en: A nail was missing when the coffin was sealed. It was later found in his coat pocket. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮灯议长·伦汀.zh: 这名乘客一直握着空票夹，说目的地写在车站的另一面。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮灯议长·伦汀.en: The passenger holds an empty ticket wallet. He says the destination is on the other side of the station. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮裂角客领誓·佩汀.zh: 它的影子有两种轮廓，轮到报姓名时，只有其中一个动嘴。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮裂角客领誓·佩汀.en: Its shadow has two outlines. Only one mouth moves when it gives a name. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮琉纹折面星客.zh: 对方知道姓名该有几个字，却总把最后一笔写到纸的另一面。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮琉纹折面星客.en: It knows how many letters a name should contain. It always finishes the last stroke on the other side of the paper. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮修灯师·泽汀.zh: 她给伤口换上新的绷带，拆下来的旧布里却没有一点血。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮修灯师·泽汀.en: She changes the dressing. There is no blood anywhere in the cloth she removes. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮巡灯使·图汀.zh: 他来报失踪，拿出的照片是自己，背面写着尚未发生的事。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·图汀.en: He comes to report a disappearance. The photograph is his own, with events that have not happened written on the back. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮巡灯使·芮汀.zh: 她拒绝进入镜头，只愿站在照片已经被裁掉的那个位置。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·芮汀.en: She refuses to enter the frame. She will stand only where the photograph has already been cropped. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮修灯师·阿芙.zh: 这名医师听诊很久，最后问你有没有梦见另一个心跳声。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮修灯师·阿芙.en: The physician listens for a long time, then asks whether you have dreamed of a second heartbeat. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮巡灯使·艾芙.zh: 他没有说谎，录音里的回答却总比你提出问题早半拍。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·艾芙.en: He is not lying. On the recording, his answers arrive a fraction before your questions. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮巡灯使·伊芙.zh: 她认得每条街，唯独说不出自己那栋房子白天在哪里。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·伊芙.en: She knows every street. She cannot say where her house goes during the day. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮巡灯使·欧芙.zh: 他把收据按日期排好，最旧的一张仍带着你掌心的温度。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·欧芙.en: He sorts the receipts by date. The oldest still carries the warmth of your hand. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮巡灯使·乌芙.zh: 电话接通后，他只听不说，隔壁房间却传来同样的呼吸。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·乌芙.en: He listens without speaking when the call connects. The same breathing comes from the next room. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮修灯师·依芙.zh: 她认得每个人的伤痕，却说不清这些记录是哪一次看诊写的。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮修灯师·依芙.en: She knows every scar. She cannot say which consultation produced the notes. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮修灯师·雅芙.zh: 药瓶上的日期早已过期，瓶内的标签却写着下周的天气。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮修灯师·雅芙.en: The medicine has expired. A label inside the bottle gives next week’s weather. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮潜印客·诺芙.zh: 锁没有被撬开的痕迹，屋里却多出一件尺寸合适的雨衣。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮潜印客·诺芙.en: The lock shows no damage. A raincoat in exactly the right size has appeared inside. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮潜印客·瑟芙.zh: 他收走你的照片，只归还底片，说照片会替别人认出你。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮潜印客·瑟芙.en: He takes your photograph and returns only the negative. He says a print lets someone else recognize you. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮铠卫·维芙.zh: 护面里传出另一个人的呼吸，他说执勤表上的姓名已经划掉了。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮铠卫·维芙.en: Someone else breathes inside the visor. He says his name has been struck from the duty roster. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮潜印客·希芙.zh: 她会替人藏起证词，但每份副本都在最不该出现的地方找到。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮潜印客·希芙.en: She hides statements for people. Every copy is found where it ought least to be. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮巡灯使·洛芙.zh: 她说自己来认领遗物，清单上每一样东西都还在你身上。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·洛芙.en: She has come to collect personal effects. Every item on the list is still on your person. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮巡灯使·米芙.zh: 他不肯在口供上落款，纸张下方却慢慢浮出一笔熟悉的字。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·米芙.en: He will not sign the statement. Familiar handwriting slowly appears at the foot of the page. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮潜印客·岚芙.zh: 他从不走有脚印的那条路，仍会在转角撞见自己的背影。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮潜印客·岚芙.en: He avoids paths with footprints. At the next corner he still finds his own back. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮潜印客·索芙.zh: 她的口袋里没有钥匙，所有钥匙的编号却记在皮肤下面。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮潜印客·索芙.en: There are no keys in her pockets. Their numbers can be read beneath her skin. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮折面星客·莱芙.zh: 它照着录音学会了敲门，敲击之间却没有留给人开门的时间。码头上的湿脚印始终没有上岸。
暮潮折面星客·莱芙.en: It learned to knock from a recording. The intervals leave nobody time to open the door. The wet footprints on the pier never reach land.

暮潮巡灯使·岑芙.zh: 她随身带着两张返程票，另一位乘客的姓名被水泡掉了。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮巡灯使·岑芙.en: She carries two return tickets. Water has washed the other passenger’s name away. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮织光蛛·塔芙.zh: 蛛网没有粘住飞虫，空出的结点却对应着几处失踪者的住址。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮织光蛛·塔芙.en: No insects are caught in the web. Its empty junctions correspond to missing persons’ addresses. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮潜印客·莫芙.zh: 他总在你转头前离开，留下的椅子却比刚坐下时更冷。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮潜印客·莫芙.en: He leaves before you turn around. The chair is colder than when he first sat down. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮潜印客·伦芙.zh: 锁没有被撬开的痕迹，屋里却多出一件尺寸合适的雨衣。码头上的湿脚印始终没有上岸。
暮潮潜印客·伦芙.en: The lock shows no damage. A raincoat in exactly the right size has appeared inside. The wet footprints on the pier never reach land.

暮潮微烛缄骨客.zh: 它的牙齿已经不齐，录音里的齿音却清楚得像贴着话筒。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮微烛缄骨客.en: Its teeth are incomplete. The sibilants on the tape sound as if its mouth is pressed to the microphone. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮铜缄铠卫.zh: 他把盾放在椅背上，凹痕朝着室内，像是防备里面的人。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮铜缄铠卫.en: He rests his shield against the chair, dents facing inward, as if the room needs containing. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮琉纹缄骨客.zh: 他记得被埋在哪里，却总把回家的路说成另一座墓的地址。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮琉纹缄骨客.en: He remembers where he was buried. His directions home always end at another grave. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮铜缄棱耳猎犬.zh: 它认得巡逻车的声音，却总比车上的无线电早一步转身。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮铜缄棱耳猎犬.en: It knows the patrol car’s sound. It turns before the radio reports the car’s arrival. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮苔痕掠风鸟.zh: 这只鸟学会了电话的铃声，来电记录却总是在它叫过后才出现。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮苔痕掠风鸟.en: The bird has learned a telephone’s ring. The call appears in the log only after it cries. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮苔痕线尾鼠.zh: 老鼠把文件边缘啃得很齐，却从来不碰写着姓名的那一栏。沉港的潮位表在低潮处画着一道门。
暮潮苔痕线尾鼠.en: The rat trims the file’s edges neatly. It never touches the column containing names. A door is drawn at low tide on the Sunken Harbor chart.

暮潮雾羽巡灯使.zh: 他记得你的脸，却坚持你们第一次见面是在明天的停尸房。码头上的湿脚印始终没有上岸。
暮潮雾羽巡灯使.en: He remembers your face. He insists you first met tomorrow, in the morgue. The wet footprints on the pier never reach land.

暮潮静棱折面星客.zh: 照片中的五官都在正确位置，合在一起却无法让人记住。码头上的湿脚印始终没有上岸。
